## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and what this change does. Link the issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results, and any prerequisites or checks that remain unverified. Use synthetic screenshots for UI work.

## Review notes

Call out migrations, provider/permission changes, licensing changes, or meaningful limitations.
